# Ratecard — full rate card

85 models, 78 verified, 14 providers. Last checked 2026-10-26. License CC BY 4.0.

## Providers
### OpenAI
- id: openai
- summary: Batch / Flex tier at 50%. Fast mode 2x. Fine-tuning closed to new users.
- source: https://platform.openai.com/docs/pricing
- checked: 2026-10-26

### Anthropic
- id: anthropic

- source: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/about-claude/pricing

## Changes
- 2026-07-30 OpenAI (tier renamed): "Priority processing" renamed "Fast mode" (2x standard token price). [https://platform.openai.com/docs/pricing]
- 2026-10-05 OpenAI (billing start): Billing for gpt-rosalind-research began ($5.00 in / $25.00 out per 1M tokens). [https://platform.openai.com/docs/pricing]
- 2026-11-21 OpenAI (promotion end (earliest)): GPT-5.6 Sol promotional pricing guaranteed "at least through November 21, 2026" ($4.00 in / $20.00 out). [https://platform.openai.com/docs/pricing]
- 2026-12-01 Google (scheduled increase): Gemini 4 Argon promotional pricing ends: input $2.00→$4.00, output $10.00→$20.00, cached $0.10→$0.20 per 1M tokens. [https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing]
- 2027-01-01 Google (scheduled increase): Gemini 3.8 Flash paid tier: input $0.75→$1.50, output $3.75→$7.50 per 1M tokens. Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS doubles the same day. [https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing]
